purpose: Four exposed original requests, one current-version diagnostic each; no causal comparison or unseen/stability/breadth acceptance
case_policy: All four exposed development/regression cases; original request/HITL/rubric unchanged; no reference injection
hypothesis: Can this repaired version provide evidence-backed answers on four exposed original requests under the existing rubric? If not, which saved stages show information loss?
resource_authority: Existing sustained development authorization plus explicit user quota-limit release; fixed four new diagnostic admissions only, no sealed final admissions
amount: unknown; theory token/call upper bounds are not money or wall-time estimates
preflight: Reuse only evidence accepted by the existing prerequisite compatibility verifier; otherwise freeze separate bounded preparation probes before dispatch
stop_policy: Retain ordinary content/provider failures in fixed serial matrix. Stop new admissions for security, budget, identity drift, lease/instance authority loss, uncertain submission or unclassified fault; reconcile before any continuation. No replacement/extra fifth run.
content_review: Original request/report/original saved source judgments lock before Trace/cost; assistant-only, single-arm nonblind. Missing intermediate artifacts remain unassessable.
exit: Close batch after four or safety stop. Confirmed common defect -> one family and fresh same-condition comparison with 3-4 scenes, >=3 tradeoffs, >=2 not used for candidate design. If usable, prepare independently held new scenes; no invented code change needed. No final24 release.

unvalidated_designs.bounded_evidence_inventory: Check whether saved retrieved evidence for decisive original questions reaches selected facts, retained analysis and report; no public intermediate evidence means unassessable, not presumed loss or support.
unvalidated_designs.complexity_contribution: Assess actual node/call contributions to delivered useful analysis alongside prior static reachability review. Run counts cannot prove the codebase is lean.
unvalidated_designs.model_and_language_reasoning: Check source versions, applicability, assumptions and condition changes; lexical citation status cannot prove semantic support.
